raw_text: A state-sponsored APT group attempted to breach the Defence Research and Development Organisation's internal research network through a supply chain attack targeting a third-party IT vendor. The attackers deployed custom malware disguised as a software update for laboratory management systems used across DRDO facilities. The National Investigation Agency has launched a probe after initial forensic analysis pointed to a South Asian threat actor with nation-state backing. CERT-In has issued advisories to all defence research organizations.
clean_text: APT supply chain attack on DRDO via compromised vendor with malware in lab software update. NIA investigating South Asian nation-state actor. CERT-In advisory to defence organizations.
